# Note

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Note`](gmeow-Note.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Note>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)

A piece of content in a personal or collective knowledge graph — an annotation body, a Zettelkasten card, a comment, or a standalone thought. Grounded as an information object whose authorship is mediated by [`Participation`](gmeow-Participation.md) / [`wasAttributedTo`](../properties/gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md), whose temporal scope is carried by the four clocks, and whose standpoint is indexed by [`accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md). Reuses [`isAbout`](../properties/gmeow-isAbout.md) and [`hasTag`](../properties/gmeow-hasTag.md) / [`Tagging`](gmeow-Tagging.md) for topic and tagging; does not mint parallel properties.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Note`](gmeow-Note.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
